objectives: Develop a physical and mathematical understanding of motion and forces.
Apply conservation laws to particles and systems of particles.
Connect theoretical predictions with observable mechanical systems.

outcomes.statement: Formulate and solve problems using Newton's laws of motion.
Apply energy, momentum and angular-momentum conservation.
Select appropriate coordinates and reference frames.

syllabus.title: Kinematics and Newton's Laws
syllabus.topics: Reference frames, vectors, motion in one and three dimensions, force and equations of motion.

syllabus.title: Conservation Laws
syllabus.topics: Work and energy, linear momentum, collisions, centre-of-mass motion and angular momentum.

syllabus.title: Oscillations
syllabus.topics: Simple harmonic motion, damped and driven oscillations, resonance and coupled oscillators.

syllabus.title: Central Forces
syllabus.topics: Two-body motion, effective potential, planetary orbits and scattering.
